name: @projexlight/hdk-watermark
summary: Watermarking primitive: apply visible (logo / time / persona name) + invisible (steganographic forensic) watermarks to images, PDFs, and video frames at egress. Underpins evidence-leak attribution + customer-portal screen-grab tracing — if a watermarked artifact surfaces in the wild, the invisible mark identifies who exported it + when.

endpoints.description: Apply a watermark; returns the new blob_id + application_id.
Fetch an application's metadata + extracted-marks (for forensics).
List watermark applications for a tenant + filters.

events.name: hdk-watermark.applied.v1
events.description: Watermark applied; carries persona_id + reason + visible/invisible flags.

events.name: hdk-watermark.extracted.v1
events.description: Invisible watermark extracted from a suspected-leak artifact; carries identified persona + confidence.

models.description: Per-application row: source_blob_id, derived_blob_id, persona_id, reason, visible_payload, invisible_payload_id.

hooks.name: applyWatermark
hooks.description: Apply visible + invisible watermarks; returns the new blob_id.

hooks.name: extractWatermark
hooks.description: Forensic extraction — given a suspected-leak artifact, recover the invisible mark + identify the persona.

scenarios.title: Auto-apply on every legal-export bundle
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on evidence.export.signed.v1 — every exported artifact gets a visible 'CONFIDENTIAL — exported by <persona> on <date>' overlay + an invisible mark for forensic recovery.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Watermarked variants written; emits .applied.v1. Original blob retained. Customer receives the watermarked bundle.

scenarios.title: Watermark customer-portal downloads with their persona
scenarios.when_to_use: Self-serve evidence download from customer portal — watermark every download with the downloading persona + timestamp for leak attribution.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Customer downloads the watermarked variant; original blob never released. Future leak can be traced back.

scenarios.title: Leak found in the wild → forensic extraction
scenarios.when_to_use: Sensitive document surfaces on a public forum; extractWatermark identifies which persona exported it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Persona + timestamp identified with confidence score. Sufficient evidence for HR / legal action.

scenarios.title: Visible-only watermark for casual sharing
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer-success rep shares a screenshot in chat; visible watermark is enough (no need for invisible forensic).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Visible-only variant. No invisible payload computation cost.

scenarios.title: Invisible watermark survives resize / re-encode
scenarios.when_to_use: Algo (DCT-domain) is chosen so that resize / re-save / re-encode preserves the invisible payload; extraction still works on the downstream artifact.
scenarios.example_code: // Algorithm picked via HDK_WATERMARK_INVISIBLE_ALGO; default 'dct-low-freq' survives typical compression.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Extraction works on resized / re-encoded leaks. Forensic chain holds.

compliance_posture.notes: Watermark application is the leak-attribution control under SOC2-CC7.2. Invisible mark survives the typical defeat attempts (resize / re-encode / screenshot of screenshot).
